title: Mars Bar Stir Fry
description: A unique and quick dessert stir fry featuring Mars bars, a fun twist on traditional desserts.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tsp of Stir, if using.
Add 1 Mars bar, sliced, and cook until melted.
Add 1 Unique bar, crushed, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the mixture is heated through.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional crushed Unique bar if desired.
